description: NWS and Partners Publications and Brochures is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Weather Service; American Red Cross. Find printable publications, brochures, and booklets that can help individuals and communities prepare for weather emergencies. These authoritative documents cover topics including climate, emergency preparedness, floods, heat, hurricanes, thunderstorms, tsunami, and winter storms, among others. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
